description: Use this when the user asks which commercial insurance coverages their business needs. Returns coverages ranked essential, recommended or optional, each with a reason, based on the confirmed class codes and the facts the user stated. Pass naics_code and iso_gl_code from classify_business after the user confirms them, and leave out facts the user did not give. Returns no prices; use get_carrier_recommendations for estimates.

business_description.description: The business activity, as confirmed with classify_business

iso_gl_code.description: Confirmed ISO GL code. For NAICS 531110 it separates 1-4 family rentals (63010) from apartment buildings (60010).

state.description: Two-letter code of the US state where the business operates, not the user's current location

vertical.description: topMatch.vertical from classify_business; derived from the class codes when omitted

name: suggest_coverages
title: Suggest coverages
